decisions.reason: As a newly launched product very close to the core packaging business and already given its own webpage, it reflects visible commitment and likely meaningful investment, so management would be inclined to continue with it.
Because it builds directly on the established bulk-container offer and is publicly presented on its own page, the firm is likely to persist with it rather than reverse a recent, related launch.

Although it appears less prominently on the website and may involve lower sunk investment than the physical products, it fits the firm's stated move toward service-based, reusable packaging, which makes withdrawal less likely in the near term.
